bio: Astri is a smuggler, a fence, and the only known bearer of a starmetal blade – a weapon of incredible cosmic power. She refuses to say where she got the sword, or how it was made, or what it cost her… but such a blade could only come from a celestial being. The price would have been dear indeed.
